data.one_liner: A widget that automatically scrolls its child into view when the child gains focus.
data.what_it_does: Ensures that a target widget, such as a text field, automatically scrolls into the viewport whenever it receives focus. You wrap your widget in the provided widget and pass the corresponding FocusNode.
use_when: You have large forms with multiple fields that need to scroll into view automatically upon focusing.
You want to improve user experience on mobile or web forms by keeping focused inputs visible.
avoid_when: You already manage scrolling manually through complex scroll controllers on every focus event.
strengths: Simple integration by wrapping the target widget
Solves a common form-scrolling issue with minimal boilerplate
weaknesses: Requires passing a FocusNode to both the wrapper and the target widget
